notes: At 5 points, T6 and T7 passed Anemone into Server 1 (which held Longevity Serum, scored T8) and jacked out without accessing; then T9-T18 ran the now-empty Server 1 twice a turn, taking Anemone net damage to no purpose (about 16 runs) and losing Revolver/Shibboleth/Info Bounty etc. T19-T23 clicked for credits to 35 with 1 card in grip while the Corp scored Yagi-Uda (Server 6, T14) and Regenesis (Server 3, T24) from remotes it never ran; T6 Transfer of Wealth into known Hafrun was pointless.
Log ends during the Runner's turn 1; the Corp iced HQ and R&D and rezzed Ansel 1.0 (6 credits) to trash Carmen and install more ice, which is a sensible play, but there is too little to judge.

After T1 the Runner never installed, played or drew a card: it held the same 5-card grip for 20 turns and clicked for credits from 12 to 83, running only into ETR ice with no breakers (Tree Line T2, Descent T11 and T20) and twice into empty Archives. The Corp scored 9 points from barely contested remotes; there was no plan at all.

Strong game: Vertigo plus Drafter taxed the R&D-focused Runner, campaigns plus Sprint/Hedge Fund kept money flowing, and the Corp scored three Project Ingatan and Melies (Seamless Launch T8/T10). Minor oddities: T7 rezzed both copies of Wage Workers so one was trashed (2 credits wasted), and Ingatan was installed and scored from naked Server 6 (T7-T8).

Clean, aggressive game: cheap Shibboleth/Revolver rig, hit HQ through Diviner for Regenesis and Fujii, used Carpe Diem/Swift for extra R&D pressure, and closed T7 with Transfer of Wealth on HQ for Longevity Serum. No real mistakes.

After an early Ingatan score, T10-T17 the Corp clicked for credits up to 38 with 6 cards in HQ, discarding most turns, and never used its 3-ice Server 2 to score while the Runner ran R&D every turn behind a single Vertigo. Megaprix was stolen from HQ T15, Melies T16 and Ingatan T17 from R&D; a competent Corp would have added R&D ice and scored out of Server 2.

From T9 to T23 the Corp sat at 1 credit, unable to rez anything, but the Runner (12-16 credits, with Buzzsaw, Boi-tata and Stargate installed T14) never ran R&D, HQ or Server 1 again; it ran Archives every turn, clicked for credits and paid 2 each turn to clear Trickster Taka's tag. It won only off two discarded Transport Monopoly in Archives; Stargate was never used, and the T1 HQ/R&D facechecks with no breakers were reasonless.

Held the same 5-card grip all game without installing a breaker, clicked for credits to 39 (T1-T10), and bounced off Tree Line/Akhet facechecks (T2, T7, T8) while the Corp scored twice from Server 1/2. T9 and T11 it ran R&D four times without the top card changing (6 wasted runs) and never ran HQ, whose ice was unrezzed with the Corp at 0-1 credits.

Solid: Ping/Unsmiling Tsarevna punished runs, Next Big Thing and two Embedded Reporting scored behind ice, and the T10 three-ice rebuild of Server 1 sealed the win. T8-T9 it clicked for credits with 11-19 credits and 7 cards in HQ (discarding 3), and never used the many tags it gave out.

Left R&D unprotected T1-T2 (clicking for credits instead) while the Runner made eight R&D runs, and scored Post-Truth Dividend from a naked Server 1 (T2-T3), which was risky. Afterwards it was tidy, scoring Tomorrow's Headline twice, Post-Truth and Embedded Reporting; Oppo Research (T5) and the many tags were never followed up.

Iced Server 1 and HQ but never R&D; after the Runner stole Tomorrow's Headline from R&D on T1 and ran it four times on T2, the Corp spent T3 drawing, playing Hedge Fund and installing a naked Server 2 card instead of icing R&D with 10 credits, and lost to two more R&D steals on T3.

Built Boi-tata, Buzzsaw, Banner and Leech but never ran Server 1 after T2, although the Corp sat at 0-4 credits all game and scored Above the Law (T4), Divested Trust twice (T7, T11) and SDS (T13) from it. It spent T7-T12 clicking for credits at 10-15 credits and running R&D/Archives, and installed Trickster Taka/Cookbook on T12 instead of contesting the 2-advanced SDS.

T2-T4 it clicked for credits up to 16 with a full HQ (discarding), then protected each remote with a single pay-through Grubber: Embedded Reporting was stolen T5, then another Embedded Reporting T6 and Next Big Thing T8 from Server 2 after the Runner had already shown it could pay. Oppo Research (T6) gave tags that were never used.

Ran open R&D 4 times on T2 without the top card changing, while Fujii sat 2-advanced in a remote the Corp could barely rez for. T5, T6 and T7 it got through Server 1's ice (Diviner, Anemone broken with Revolver) and jacked out without accessing the Fujii that was scored T9 (one steal would have put it at 6 points); T10 it ran Server 3 instead of the advanced Yagi-Uda in Server 1 with the Corp broke.

Efficient: Jailbreak on R&D and Docklands Pass on HQ took 5 points by T3, then Regenesis through Hafrun/Konjin and a final Jailbreak R&D steal. Minor: T5 continued into a second unrezzed Tatu-Bola with 0 credits, and economy was thin throughout.

T2's Ansel 1.0 rez (6 credits) used its install subroutine to put Melies City Luxury Line into naked Server 1, trashing its own rezzed Otto Campaign, and the Runner stole it the same turn. The Corp then spent most turns at 0-3 credits, held a second Melies under a single Wave on R&D (stolen T6) and lost T7 to Architect Deployment Test stolen from a one-ice remote.

Steady single R&D run each turn with Buzzsaw won it, but the Runner sat on 4-6 credits with a full grip (discarding T11, T16), never spent its Leech counters or used Banner, and repeatedly ran Archives. T17 it facechecked a fresh Archives ice into a 16-credit Corp (Hammer trashed Fencer Fueno and Leech), then ran into the known Hammer again on T19.

T1 Ansel 1.0's install subroutine put Megaprix Qualifier into naked Server 1 over its rezzed Otto Campaign (stolen at once), leaving the Corp at 1 credit for four turns. Later, with 15-20 credits (T9-T12), it never added a second ice to HQ (Ansel only) or ETR ice to R&D (Drafter only), and lost Megaprix and Ingatan from HQ and the final Ingatan from R&D, clicking for credits on T12.

Left HQ and R&D unprotected T1-T2 (Megaprix and later Ingatan were lost from R&D), but then Vertigo plus Drafter slowed the Runner, Tranquility Home Grid and Bloop (via Architect Deployment Test) defended the remotes, and it scored two Ingatan and two Architect Deployment Test. Generally competent.

T1-T4 ran R&D three or four times a turn without the top card changing (about 10 wasted runs), and never ran HQ, even on T4-T5 when the Corp had 0-3 credits and HQ's ice was unrezzed. T5-T11 it clicked for credits up to 35 with an unplayed 5-card grip and no breakers while the Corp scored SDS and Divested Trust out of Server 1.
